content:
maria: Quick check — can we run an int8 vs int4 vs fp8 perf + quality wedge for gpt-small-7b on A100-40GB? Need numbers for next Friday. Specifically: p95 latency (seq=512), throughput (bs=8), and MMLU dev on our 2k sampled eval set. Include logs and compare vs q32 baseline.

josh: I can run int8/int4 tonight. Which quant profile? 'safe-acc' or 'optim-2'?

maria: start with 'safe-acc' (matches last PR). Also run an 'aggressive' int4 profile to see worst-case quality.

priya: eng-ml heads-up — any FP8 kernel issues on driver 510 we should be aware of?

ryan: FP8 uses the new nvptx kernels; on 510 we've seen NaNs in GEMM for some sparsity patterns. I can run a quick smoke on node-3.

ci-bot: perf job queued: #run-7421 — bench_runner.py started on node-3 :gear:

devon: Use bench/bench_runner.py with flags like:
```
python bench/bench_runner.py --model gpt-small-7b --quant {int8,int4,fp8} --seq 512 --bs 8 --eval-set sample2k --runs 10 --kv-cache --calib-samples 256
```
That should give you latency/throughput + eval run.

josh: quick raw runs (no kv-cache, aggressive int4):
- int8: p95 24ms, throughput 230 tok/s, MMLU 72.8%
- int4 (aggr): p95 20ms, throughput 260 tok/s, MMLU 69.0%
I know the int4 quality looks rough — sharing early numbers.

maria: Wait int4 p95 lower than int8 — odd. Did you enable KV cache? Also confirm batch pipeline didn't accidentally coalesce requests.

josh: KV-cache was off. Re-running with --kv-cache and safe-acc profile. Also note aggressive int4 removed per-channel scale recovery which hurts quality.

priya: For fp8, remember to set activation scaling hooks; we've seen ~1.5% drop on Code eval in previous runs when scaling wasn't tuned.

devon: Add a 256-sample calibration pass to stabilize int4: --calib-samples 256. Also run prompt_set 'edge-cases-v2' for diversity.

ryan: I'll correlate the perf alert from earlier (node-3 had transient disk IO). Might explain noisy p95.

josh: re-run (kv-cache + safe-acc + calib):
- int8: p95 22ms, throughput 245 tok/s, MMLU 72.6%
- int4 (safe-acc): p95 21ms, throughput 255 tok/s, MMLU 70.2%
- fp8: p95 18ms, throughput 310 tok/s, MMLU 71.9% (0.3% run-to-run instability)
Logs show steady tokens/sec but occasional GEMM warnings for fp8.

maria: Nice. Can you paste exact commands and tail -n 40 of logs for each run? Also include the eval config (random seed, eval batch size).

josh: Commands + sample logs:
```
# int8
python bench/bench_runner.py --model gpt-small-7b --quant int8 --seq 512 --bs 8 --eval-set sample2k --runs 10 --kv-cache --calib-samples 256 --profile safe-acc
# tail of run
[bench] run=10 mean_latency=18.7ms p95=22.1ms throughput=245.2 tok/s eval.mmlu=72.58

# int4
python bench/bench_runner.py --model gpt-small-7b --quant int4 --seq 512 --bs 8 --eval-set sample2k --runs 10 --kv-cache --calib-samples 256 --profile safe-acc
[bench] run=10 mean_latency=19.3ms p95=21.0ms throughput=255.1 tok/s eval.mmlu=70.18

# fp8
python bench/bench_runner.py --model gpt-small-7b --quant fp8 --seq 512 --bs 8 --eval-set sample2k --runs 10 --kv-cache --calib-samples 256 --profile safe-acc
[bench] run=10 mean_latency=16.0ms p95=18.4ms throughput=310.7 tok/s eval.mmlu=71.92
[warn] fp8_gemm: detected small NaN spike (count=3) — observed on iteration 47
```

priya: Did you run with fused attention kernels or the fallback? That can affect fp8 stability.

josh: fused attention enabled for int8/int4. FP8 used fallback for attention (no fused kernel yet) — that explains some perf/instability variance.

devon: Two follow-ups: 1) run prompt_set 'edge-cases-v2' and report top-3 failure modes; 2) push logs to s3://redwood-qa/quant/1742101123/ so we can attach to the PR.

maria: Plan: josh to finalize runs (kv-cache + calib + edge-cases) by EOD tomorrow; ryan to check node-3 perf alerts and rule out infra noise; priya & devon to review quality diffs and recommend quant profiles (safe-acc vs optim-2) with specific knobs. I'll draft a short doc with recommended knobs for the release and link it here.

ryan: I'll check node-3 and re-run the smoke for FP8 kernels under driver 510. If I see NaNs reproducible I'll open an infra ticket.

priya: Adding a 1-hr sync on Thursday afternoon in case we need to triage results.

maria: Thanks all :thumbsup:
